scripts.build:verified: tsx tooling/verification/cli.ts run production-build -- pnpm build
scripts.lint: tsx tooling/verification/cli.ts run lint -- pnpm exec eslint .
scripts.typecheck: tsx tooling/verification/cli.ts run typecheck -- pnpm typecheck:raw
scripts.test:unit: tsx tooling/verification/cli.ts run unit-tests -- pnpm exec vitest run
scripts.test:browser: tsx tooling/verification/cli.ts run browser-tests -- pnpm test:browser:raw

scripts.test:quality: pnpm test:accessibility && pnpm test:browser:critical && pnpm test:fallbacks
scripts.test:accessibility: tsx tooling/verification/cli.ts run accessibility-tests -- pnpm test:accessibility:raw
scripts.test:browser:critical: tsx tooling/verification/cli.ts run critical-browser-journeys -- pnpm test:browser:critical:raw
scripts.test:fallbacks: tsx tooling/verification/cli.ts run fallback-tests -- pnpm test:fallbacks:raw
scripts.test:audio-latency: tsx tooling/verification/cli.ts run audio-latency -- pnpm exec playwright test tests/browser/synth.spec.ts --grep loads.native.audio
scripts.test:realtime: tsx tooling/verification/cli.ts run realtime-runtime -- pnpm exec vitest run tests/presentation tests/realtime
